decisions.decision: Repair the visual-regression project fully and make it blocking, rather than retire it
decisions.rationale: Operator decision 2026-08-11 after evidence it had been non-functional since the base-dataset merge (baselines depicted a candidate e2e/base never seeds; PNGs Mac-generated at v1.2; no re-baseline process in CI; job was continue-on-error)

decisions.decision: Fix the top-tier sweep findings (F1, F2, F4, F5, F12, F14); defer F3, F9, F10, F13, F15-F20
decisions.rationale: Orchestrator scope call — deferred items are unit-test quality with no claimed guarantee resting on them. Stated to the operator, not silently narrowed.

decisions.decision: Raw-key scanner derives its key set from the UNION of runtime catalog + type-gen source + generated TranslationKey union
decisions.rationale: The negative control broke the first design: a set derived from the runtime catalog alone loses a key at the same instant the app starts rendering it raw, so the scan goes green on the exact defect it exists to catch. TypeScript does not cover it either (t() is typed from a different directory).

decisions.decision: Baselines generated in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble on linux/amd64, not on the developer Mac
decisions.rationale: Mac font rendering differs from ubuntu CI; Mac-generated baselines would fail permanently — the exact trap that left the project broken.

decisions.decision: E2E port identity must assert the SERVED APP by response content, not the listener process type
decisions.rationale: A foreign Vite dev server from an unrelated project IS a node process and passed the DEF-135-03 check; two runs silently scanned the wrong application before it was caught.

next_action: Spawn gsd-verifier on Phase 136 (goal-backward, adversarial, verify each guard DISCRIMINATES rather than merely exists). Then resolve D-136-06-1 with the operator. Then /gsd-complete-milestone for v2.14.
context_notes: Three phases ran back-to-back this session (134 defect closure, 135 coverage carry-overs, 136 fake-guard remediation + visual repair), all on branch feat-gsd-roadmap in the main repo (no worktrees — the waves contend on a single :5173 and one local Supabase, so isolating executors would give private filesystems while still fighting over shared singletons). The through-line: every guard must be proven to FAIL against an injected regression, not merely to pass. That discipline caught a self-defeating scanner design, a perf budget blind to a 10x regression, eleven subset matchers that passed a no-op filter, and a wall-clock assertion that could not see a 327-query N+1. Two API 'Connection closed mid-response' drops occurred; both recovered by checking disk state then SendMessage-resuming the SAME agent (never respawning) — see memory project_gsd_executor_api_drop_recovery.
